images.caption: Figure 4:Raw MD metric profiles for representative MotifBench problems discussed in the text.Rows are benchmark problems, with the number of contributing models solved by MotifBench in parentheses. Columns show motif RMSD mean difference, scaffold RMSD mean difference, contact Pearson similarity, weighted contact-map absolute difference, PCA FES Pearson similarity, and TICA FES Pearson similarity. Blue/red cells pass/fail the metric cutoffs as discussed in appendixC. Takeaway: compact local motifs pass most checks, while interface-like or context-dependent cases fail in contacts, FES, or scaffold stability.
